name: sports-coaching
description: Coaches teach a sport one on one or in small groups, paid per session, in person or online.

description.description: The coaching: what is taught, and how.

price.description: The price of one session, per person.

payment.description: How a session may be paid: direct, session, or both.

sports.description: The sports the coaching is for.

levels.description: The levels the coaching is for.

groupSize.description: The most people in one session: 1 for one on one.

minutes.description: How long one session lasts, in minutes.

place.description: Where sessions are held, online, or both.

hours.description: When sessions can be held, each week.

howDealsGo: The coach and the student, or a parent for a child, agree in messages on the sport, the times and the place, and pay direct or by the session schedule. After a session each may review the other. Each review names the post.
